title: Apple challenges UK government’s latest demand for iCloud backdoor: report
excerpt: Apple has appealed a new legal demand by the U.K. government, which critics say could threaten the privacy rights of users all over the world.
content_html:
In Brief

Posted:

11:54 AM PDT · August 3, 2026

Apple is challenging another legal demand by the U.K. government to access the encrypted data of its users in the country, according to Financial Times.

The company reportedly filed a complaint with the U.K.’s Investigatory Powers Tribunal, a court that hears cases related to government surveillance, after the government last year issued a “technical capability notice.” The notice is a secret government legal order for demanding access to users’ data, even if the data is encrypted.

For critics, this kind of demand is the equivalent of requesting a backdoor into Apple’s cloud backups that have Advanced Data Protection (ADP) switched on, which makes the data end-to-end encrypted and inaccessible to anyone other than the customer, including Apple.

This new challenge comes a year after a similar fight between Apple and the U.K. government. In early 2025, London issued a secret order to Apple demanding access to users’ encrypted iCloud backups, which was later dropped following the intervention of the Trump administration.

After the first order, the company reacted by removing the ability of U.K. users to use ADP. Then, in October, the U.K. issued a second order, which Apple is now challenging.

Apple did not respond to TechCrunch’s request for comment.

content_html_zh:
简介

发布：

太平洋夏令时间 11:54 · 2026 年 8 月 3 日

据《金融时报》报道，苹果公司正在挑战英国政府的另一项法律要求，要求其访问该国用户的加密数据。

据报道，在英国政府去年发布“技术能力通知”后，该公司向英国调查权力法庭提起诉讼，该法庭负责审理与政府监视相关的案件。 该通知是一项秘密政府法律命令，要求访问用户数据，即使数据是加密的。

对于批评者来说，这种要求相当于要求苹果的云备份打开后门，该后门打开了高级数据保护（ADP），这使得数据被端到端加密，并且除了客户（包括苹果）之外的任何人都无法访问。

这一新的挑战是在苹果公司与英国政府之间发生过类似的争斗一年后出现的。 2025 年初，伦敦向苹果发布了一项秘密命令，要求访问用户的加密 iCloud 备份，但该命令后来在特朗普政府干预后被撤销。

在收到第一个订单后，该公司的反应是取消了英国用户使用 ADP 的能力。 然后，在 10 月份，英国发布了第二项命令，苹果现在正在对该命令提出质疑。

苹果没有回应 TechCrunch 的置评请求。
